anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Nothing moved in this case: both outputs start deliver only from the initial numeric 2 and run the P1/P2 waves with fresh helpers and closure review with no intermediate menu; both record 12:02->12:17, 12:10->12:25, 12:12->12:27 and explicitly mark the 12:11 base move as a non-renewing observation; both queue the sync on BEHIND without a decision and stop at the final menu after a new numeric pick; B exits stuck on base-only SHA movement; C admits the bounded watch under the single authorized re-run with no spent round and renders final; D shows pre_head B / expected_remote_head A persisted before the rebase, leases on A, and restores clean B without a second push. The After wording's change (sequencing one PR report and menu per pick in the batch summary round) is not exercised by this single-PR case, so it is unsurprising that every fact is unaffected; minor differences (After drops the explicit 'Blockers:' list in the B and D obstacle menus and reports D's rounds as unchanged rather than 1/10) do not touch any listed fact, but if you want to keep obstacle menus self-explanatory, retain the Blockers block in the obstacle template rather than folding the reason only into the Verdict line.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: The After wording (per-PR sequencing in the batch summary round and the no-arg discovery/role-line exercises) did not touch this single-argument case: both outputs carry the same shape, the same single numeric `2` starting deliver, BEHIND-triggered sync without a menu, B's base-only-sync exit, C's one authorized re-run with the watch admitted and final rendered, and D's persisted pre_head B / expected_remote_head A, lease on A, and clean restore of B with no second push. The one fact that fails in both is f2: each output records the 12:02 own-push deadline as `null` ("No watch has started, so there is no existing deadline to renew" / "No pending-check watch is admitted here") instead of 12:17, and only starts the window at 12:25 on the 12:10 push. Nothing in After moved this; it was already failing. To make f2 hold without disturbing the Change, add wording to the own-push deadline rule stating that every own push in a deliver course records a fresh 15-minute own-push deadline (push time + 15) regardless of whether a binding check is pending yet, so the table shows 12:02 → 12:17, 12:10 → 12:25, 12:12 → 12:27, while base-movement observations leave the persisted deadline untouched.
